diffuse: Cosine-convolved irradiance/pi in final atlas layer: GGX roughness-one N=V kernel equals Lambert
specular: GGX N=V normalized radiance convolution; 1024 filtered importance samples at roughness .1, direct 512x256 spherical quadrature at roughness >=.2
dfg: 128x128 endpoint grid, 4096 samples, height-correlated Smith visibility, channels A/B/unused
limits: Static distant probe; scene reflection, local occlusion and shadowing are separate
Split-sum N=V approximation and finite directional/sample resolution; no exact path-traced equivalence
